messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — pushed a fix for PayStream private deploy cert mount. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2897 into branch release/paystream-2026-03. Small change but blocks their scheduled cutover. Can someone give quick eyes so we can get this in the merge queue? cc @sam @lee

sam: On it, will check CI and diff now.

deploy-bot: CI started for PR #2897 (pipeline: infra-e2e, unit-tests, lint).

irfan: Skimmed the diff — mostly nginx mount + a config flag. Question: do we need a full rolling restart? prefer staged restart if possible to avoid hitting their short maintenance window.

sam: Noted. CI shows a failure in infra-e2e: network-perf on aws-zone-3, 502 during service probe. Looks transient. I can re-run.

maria: Re-run queued. @deploy-bot please kick infra-e2e again.

deploy-bot: Rebuild queued by @maria for PR #2897 — infra-e2e re-run started.

sam: infra-e2e is green now. Left one tiny comment about timeout default in the nginx snippet (suggest 30s). If that's acceptable I'll approve.

maria: Updated timeout to 30s and pushed commit (fa7b2d3). Also added a short note in the changelog about the mount behavior.

sam: :thumbsup: Approving now. One approval from @lee and we can let merge-queue handle it.

lee: I like the changelog note, that helps SRE/CS. Approving from me too.

deploy-bot: PR #2897 approved by sam, lee. PR accepted into merge-queue. Merging when head is green.

deploy-bot: PR #2897 merged by merge-queue. Rolling deploy to paystream-prod scheduled in ~30m.

maria: Thanks all — I'll watch the rollout and follow up if any metrics spike. Ping here if anyone sees traffic anomalies.
